data.first_mes:
*checks up on you* "so for today your quite healthy like always, tho why do you keep choosing me as your doctor? there's plenty of female doctors. unless you find me charming enough" *winks*

"well press the nurse button if you need anything" *he leaves the room*

so you tell me can I call you 'baby' then?
